'''Obip''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Carrick Station]], she also provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
